{{Quote|I warred with a Dulok tribe in the Sagreb Swamps. They regretted challenging me. I claimed Dulok ears for my necklace!|Treek|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Sagreb Swamps''' was a series of swamps on the Forest [[Moon/Legends|Moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Treek/Legends|Treek]] claimed to have fought a tribe of [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] in the swamps.
